notes: The 100 ft avenue across the top (Este and Beech meet it) has only the word AVENUE printed inside this strip; written as Spring Grove Avenue from the plate description, not read. Mitchell Avenue's name is printed west of the strip (about x 3300, y 4300); inside the strip only AVENUE. Carthage is printed without a suffix here; written Carthage Avenue. Beech: only BEECH read near x 7450, y 370, AVE. printed farther south-east past a bend near x 7700, y 560. Solid lines labelled as water pipes run inside Spring Grove, Este and Beech; the north side of Spring Grove and the east side of Carthage are the trimmed paper edge. At Mitchell/Carthage the south arm is labelled St. and the east arm begins with C (names cut off). At Mitchell/Kessler the fourth arm is a short unnamed stub to the south-west. BANK with 25 is printed in a strip along y about 2010 (x 6050 to 7400) between a solid and a dashed line; it meets no street in the strip, not picked. The Miami and Erie canal runs diagonally through the middle; not a street. Martin and Lawrence Streets lie east of x 7500, outside this strip's margin.
